problem: Native Excel external-data coverage exposed a successful empty query-table catalog, rejected table-definition query ownership, discarded alternate-URL metadata, destructive query-table rename serialization, failed external-link inverse replay, and non-exact connection lifecycle inverse publication.
changes: Traverse worksheet query-table relationships and one-level table-definition owners. Validate internal content-type closure, table cardinality, duplicate targets and unique worksheet ownership. Part views report their actual owner. Relationship-ID lookup refuses cross-owner collisions; replace_part selects a full owned package part name.
Connections graph validation admits table-definition query owners and computes their worksheet incoming edges once. Invalid, duplicate, external and orphan query graphs remain errors.
Recognize the already-modeled alternateUrls namespace during MCE preprocessing, so native mc:Ignorable declarations do not erase supported metadata. Targets remain strings and are never opened.

Preserve an unchanged query definition or name-only replacement with a bounded source splice. BOM, quote style, entities, revision UID, compatibility declarations and opaque siblings remain exact. Other replacements retain explicit whole-definition writer semantics.

Replay external-link and connections patches through captured part changes while retaining existing semantic source guards. Capture only named owned parts/workbook metadata, with exact relationship and manifest images; unrelated payloads are not materialized by a whole-package capture.
Refuse table-owned removal/reorder and field rebinding until table/column query bindings can be updated together. Revise the query-table matrix row to partial instead of claiming universal CRUD.
Add seven native regressions and four synthetic tests, strengthening owner identity and binding guards. Index three newly asserted feature rows without changing historical evidence labels.

verification_scope.queries: The native Power Query sheet has ExternalData_1 at /xl/queryTables/queryTable1.xml owned by /xl/tables/table1.xml and connection2, with nextId4 and exact ID/Category/Amount IDs1/2/3 and tableColumnId bindings. Sheet1 has direct LEGACY_CSV_010 at queryTable2.xml owned by sheet2.xml and connection1. Renaming either changes exactly its source name occurrence, preserves every other member and inverts after temporary save/reopen.
verification_scope.connections: The native graph has Text connection1 with codePage10000, comma true/tab false, three fields and the exact retained source path; OleDb connection2 has the Microsoft.Mashup.OleDb.1 provider string, SELECT command and keepAlive metadata. Description edits preserve all query/data/mashup members. Creating a separate inert id7 owner in excel-links-objects.xlsx, saving/reopening, removing its last connection and replaying both inverses preserve exact original member bytes, including manifests and workbook relationship XML.
verification_scope.external_links: The primary target is excel-values-formulas-chart.xlsx; the absolute alternate rId2 path is retained exactly. Source sheets are Sales chart,Sheet1,Sheet2; caches are sheet1 row6 D6=49.75 and sheet2 row4 B4=14. Adding NATIVE_DRIVE_020 changes only the external-link XML and preserves both inert target relationships and all caches. Inverse restores every original member byte.
verification_scope.ownership: Equal local relationship IDs under separate owner parts cannot silently select another query. A full part-name replacement updates only the selected definition. Table-owned deletion/reorder and field-ID/table-column rebinding are explicit Unsupported results with no staged change. External/duplicate/orphan edges are rejected.
verification_scope.source_contract: The part-level engines promise content types, payloads and relationship state, not the original ZIP compression. Initial tests over-assumed full-archive identity; inspection of part_edit.rs and all member bytes established the correct contract. The permanent tests require identical member sets and every member byte after inverse. The legacy metadata-only connection inverse already met that member contract; its lifecycle inverse failed content types and workbook relationships, as the isolated probe demonstrates.
verification_scope.limitations: No Office reopen, query execution, provider activation, refresh, credential use, target access, formula computation or macro execution. Whole query-definition replacements can canonicalize their owned XML; only the tested name-only edit has an exact source-splice assertion. Broader table conversion/rebinding remains open.
